theorems.name: Submission.dorag_gc_campanato_continuous_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (Ω : Set (Euclid n)) (C s₁ : ℝ), 0 < n → IsOpen Ω → 0 ≤ C → 0 < s₁ → (∀ᵐ v ∂volume, v ∈ Ω → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₁ → ∫⁻ w in ball v s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin n, ‖(fderiv ℝ f w - fderiv ℝ f v) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * s ^ (n + 1))) → ∃ g : Euclid n → (Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), ContinuousOn g Ω ∧ ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, v ∈ Ω → HasFDerivAt f (g v) v
